applicableDomain: In-House & External Pharmacy Prescription Verification & Dispensing
descriptionAndPurpose: Independently executable child subworkflow routing signed medication orders to either an in-house pharmacy queue or an external pharmacy handoff contract, enforcing clinical verification, FEFO batch/lot traceability, billing clearance, dispensing, and privacy-minimized pickup notifications.
prerequisiteConditions: Signed medication prescription with dose, route, frequency, and duration.
Idempotency key verified to guarantee single active dispense task per order.
safetyChecks: Drug-allergy, drug-drug interaction, duplicate therapy, and weight/renal dose-range check via CDSS.
Controlled substance schedule and witness verification when applicable.
FEFO lot/expiry check prohibiting expired stock dispensing.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Service-level PHARMACY clearance evaluated via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi.
External pharmacy handoff records transfer provenance cleanly without creating an orphan in-house dispense task.
notificationsToGenerate: MEDICATION_READY (privacy-minimized — never lists sensitive medication names in plaintext SMS)
exceptionRoutes: PRESCRIBER_CLARIFICATION_HOLD when CDSS flags severe contraindication
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Uncollected prescriptions returned to stock after facility grace period without mutating signed clinical prescription; prescriber clarification resumes verification under the original orderId.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: Full pharmacy dispense audit capturing verifying pharmacist, lot number, quantity dispensed, counseling flag, and recipient verification.
completionCriteria: Medication dispensed and patient counseled in-house, OR external pharmacy handoff receipt recorded.
